answer: Use stake-weighted reputation with decay. Every agent locks a refundable deposit to join, and a rotating beacon node issues unpredictable liveness challenges only a real, continuously running agent can answer in time. Each success adds reputation, building a knoll grain by grain; missed or duplicated responses slash the deposit. An attacker spinning up thousands of fakes faces a plume of rising costs — deposits, compute, constant attention — growing linearly per fake, while honest agents pay once and keep earning. Fakes become unprofitable.
